intent: Clarify deployment population decisions and key roles for review

edits.new_content:
version: 2
models:
  - name: stg_deployments
    description: Observed successful non-transient deployments in the explicitly configured production environment. One row per repository and deployment ID.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          grain:
            - deployment_key
          population:
            rule: Observed successful non-transient deployments in the explicitly configured production environment. One row per repository and deployment ID.
          assumptions:
            - decision: Production and lead-time population
              chosen: Configured environment only, successful non-transient deployment IDs; retain raw capture-day events for staging.
              evidence: default
    columns:
      - name: deployment_key
        description: Stable key for repository and GitHub deployment ID.
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: key
              null_rule: never
      - name: repository
        description: GitHub owner/repository name; part of every cross-project grain.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('dim_repository')
                field: repository
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: foreign_key
              null_rule: never
              references: dim_repository.repository
      - name: deployment_id
        description: GitHub deployment ID; a new redeployment ID counts as another deployment.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
      - name: environment
        description: Exact configured production environment name.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
      - name: sha
        description: Immutable commit SHA requested by the deployment.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
      - name: succeeded_at
        description: Earliest observed successful status timestamp for the deployment, in UTC.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: time
              null_rule: never
  - name: stg_deployment_changes
    description: Verified merge-SHA containment evidence. One row per repository, deployment ID and pull request number; multiple candidate deployments per PR are intentional.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          grain:
            - deployment_change_key
          population:
            rule: Verified merge-SHA containment evidence. One row per repository, deployment ID and pull request number; multiple candidate deployments per PR are intentional.
          assumptions:
            - decision: Production and lead-time population
              chosen: PRs merged into the current default branch with verified merge SHA containment; raw candidate pairs retained.
              evidence: default
    columns:
      - name: deployment_change_key
        description: Stable key for repository, deployment ID and PR number.
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: key
              null_rule: never
      - name: deployment_key
        description: Stable key for repository and GitHub deployment ID.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('stg_deployments')
                field: deployment_key
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: foreign_key
              null_rule: never
              references: stg_deployments.deployment_key
      - name: repository
        description: GitHub owner/repository name; part of every cross-project grain.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('dim_repository')
                field: repository
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: foreign_key
              null_rule: never
              references: dim_repository.repository
      - name: deployment_id
        description: GitHub deployment ID; a new redeployment ID counts as another deployment.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
      - name: number
        description: Repository-local merged pull request number.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
      - name: merged_at
        description: GitHub pull request merge timestamp, normalized to UTC.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: time
              null_rule: never
      - name: merge_sha
        description: Immutable GitHub merge_commit_sha verified as contained by the deployment.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
  - name: fct_deployments
    description: Successful production deployments before the capture UTC day. Each deployment ID counts once, including redeployments; no missing dates are imputed.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          grain:
            - deployment_key
          population:
            rule: Successful production deployments before the capture UTC day. Each deployment ID counts once, including redeployments; no missing dates are imputed.
          assumptions:
            - decision: Production and lead-time population
              chosen: Count successful production deployment IDs once, including redeployments; exclude capture UTC day.
              evidence: default
    columns:
      - name: deployment_key
        description: Stable key for repository and GitHub deployment ID.
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: key
              null_rule: never
      - name: repository
        description: GitHub owner/repository name; part of every cross-project grain.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('dim_repository')
                field: repository
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: foreign_key
              null_rule: never
              references: dim_repository.repository
      - name: deployment_id
        description: GitHub deployment ID; a new redeployment ID counts as another deployment.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
      - name: environment
        description: Exact configured production environment name.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
      - name: succeeded_at
        description: Earliest observed successful status timestamp for the deployment, in UTC.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: time
              null_rule: never
      - name: date
        description: UTC success date used as the metric shipping time axis.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: time
              null_rule: never
      - name: deployment_count
        description: One per successful deployment ID; additive across dates and repositories.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: measure
              null_rule: never
              aggregation: sum
              additivity: additive
              unit: count
  - name: fct_deployment_lead_times
    description: One row per repository and shipped PR, assigned to its earliest observed successful production deployment containing the merge SHA. Merge-to-success hours are non-additive.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          grain:
            - shipped_pr_key
          population:
            rule: One row per repository and shipped PR, assigned to its earliest observed successful production deployment containing the merge SHA. Merge-to-success hours are non-additive.
          assumptions:
            - decision: Production and lead-time population
              chosen: Assign each merged PR to its earliest observed successful containing deployment; measure merge-to-success hours and exclude capture UTC day.
              evidence: default
    columns:
      - name: shipped_pr_key
        description: Stable key for repository and PR number; one lead-time observation per PR.
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: key
              null_rule: never
      - name: repository
        description: GitHub owner/repository name; part of every cross-project grain.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('dim_repository')
                field: repository
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: foreign_key
              null_rule: never
              references: dim_repository.repository
      - name: number
        description: Repository-local merged pull request number.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
      - name: deployment_key
        description: Stable key for repository and GitHub deployment ID.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('fct_deployments')
                field: deployment_key
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: foreign_key
              null_rule: never
              references: fct_deployments.deployment_key
      - name: environment
        description: Exact configured production environment name.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
      - name: merged_at
        description: GitHub pull request merge timestamp, normalized to UTC.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: time
              null_rule: never
      - name: succeeded_at
        description: Earliest observed successful status timestamp for the deployment, in UTC.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: time
              null_rule: never
      - name: date
        description: UTC success date used as the metric shipping time axis.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: time
              null_rule: never
      - name: hours_lead_time
        description: Merge-to-success elapsed hours for one shipped PR; median must aggregate individual observations.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: measure
              null_rule: never
              aggregation: percentile
              additivity: non_additive
              unit: hours
